Mamata Banerjee Demands Election Commissioner's Arrest, Bengal Repoll

West Bengal Chief Minister Mamata Banerjee has demanded the arrest of Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar and called for fresh Assembly polls in Bengal. This demand comes amid a controversy described as an 'EC SIR split' row. Banerjee stated that INDIA bloc partners have discussed the matter and plan to meet soon.
